notes.text: Alex Alaniz told the owner he was hired by Yannis Tzamouranis at Dynegy on 3 July 2001 (weather group), after previously being a $25K/annum post-doc; this preempted his planned 24 July 2001 appointment with the owner.

notes.text: Thomas J. Murphy (VP Business Strategies, Toshiba America Information Systems) thanked the owner for meeting Toshiba on Tuesday to present the Boltzmann concepts and model, followed by lunch at Brennan's.

Thomas J. Murphy proposed a small joint Enron-Toshiba research or prototype project to test, analyze and benchmark the Boltzmann Model concept for feasibility and business benefit, and asked for the owner's thoughts.
Toshiba sent the owner the 2 briefings from the meeting (incl. 'Toshiba Intro Brief (Enron 07312001)') plus published papers on the Boltzmann Model, for internal distribution as appropriate.

The Toshiba Boltzmann Model discussion involved, besides the owner, Alex Huang, Robert Lee, Rabi De, Sandeep Kohli and Vasant Shanbhogue (cc'd), with Toshiba's Takahiro Tatsumi, Yuuji Uenohara and Makoto Yoshida.
Toshiba's eSolutions Company is seeking a collaboration with Enron; contact is Thomas J. Murphy, Toshiba Consultant Center in Fairfax, Herndon VA, office 703.375.0408.
